all_scores.response:
Decoder-only (GPT-like / causal) language models **for Portuguese** (Portuguese-first, Portuguese-trained, or explicitly Portuguese-adapted) that were released **by the end of 2024** include the following. I’m excluding encoder-only (BERT) and encoder–decoder (T5) models.

## Open / public weights (Hugging Face / GitHub)

### Foundation / continued-pretraining Portuguese LLMs (decoder-only)
- **Sabiá-7B (Maritaca AI)** — Portuguese LM based on LLaMA-1 7B architecture (open weights under LLaMA-1 terms).  
  HF: https://huggingface.co/maritaca-ai/sabia-7b  
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2304.07880.pdf

- **Gervásio PT\*** (PORTULAN) — open decoder-only Portuguese models with **PT-BR** and **PT-PT** variants (7B and 70B checkpoints listed).  
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.18766  
  HF (examples):  
  • PT-BR 7B: https://huggingface.co/PORTULAN/gervasio-7b-portuguese-ptbr-decoder  
  • PT-PT 7B: https://huggingface.co/PORTULAN/gervasio-7b-portuguese-ptpt-decoder  
  • PT-PT 70B: https://huggingface.co/PORTULAN/gervasio-70b-portuguese-ptpt-decoder

- **GlórIA-1.3B (NOVA / NOVA LINCS)** — European Portuguese-focused generative LM (decoder-only; GPT-Neo family).  
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.12969 (also: https://aclanthology.org/2024.propor-1.45/)  
  HF: https://huggingface.co/NOVA-vision-language/GlorIA-1.3B

- **TeenyTinyLlama (PT-BR)** — small Portuguese (Brazil) decoder-only LMs (trained for PT-BR; includes chat variant).  
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.16640  
  HF (examples):  
  • https://huggingface.co/nicholasKluge/TeenyTinyLlama-460m  
  • https://huggingface.co/nicholasKluge/TeenyTinyLlama-460m-Chat

- **Canarim-7B** — Portuguese LLM continued-pretrained from LLaMA-2 7B (decoder-only).  
  HF: https://huggingface.co/dominguesm/canarim-7b

- **Tucano-1b1 (TucanoBR)** — Portuguese-only decoder-only foundation model released in 2024.  
  HF: https://huggingface.co/TucanoBR/Tucano-1b1  
  (Model card links arXiv preprint: https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.07854)

### Instruction / chat fine-tunes explicitly for Portuguese (decoder-only)
- **BODE / “Bode” (Recogna NLP)** — PT-BR Alpaca-style instruction fine-tunes on LLaMA-2 (7B/13B).  
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.02909

  HF: https://huggingface.co/lrds-code/boana-7b-instruct

  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.11878  
  HF: https://huggingface.co/22h/open-cabrita3b

### GPT-2 / small GPT-family Portuguese generators (decoder-only)
- **GPorTuguese-2 (Portuguese GPT-2 small)** — classic Portuguese GPT-2 checkpoint.  
  HF: https://huggingface.co/pierreguillou/gpt2-small-portuguese

  GitHub: https://github.com/HAILab-PUCPR/gpt2-bio-pt  
  HF: https://huggingface.co/pucpr/gpt2-bio-pt

## Elden Ring (Base Game) — Remembrance Bosses & All Trade Rewards

All **base-game Remembrances** can be exchanged with **Enia (Finger Reader) at Roundtable Hold** via **“Receive power from remembrance”**.  
Each Remembrance has **exactly 2 possible rewards** (you choose one per Remembrance copy). To obtain **both** in one playthrough, you must **duplicate the Remembrance** at a **Walking Mausoleum**.

### 1) Godrick the Grafted — *Remembrance of the Grafted*
- **Axe of Godrick** (weapon)
- **Grafted Dragon** (weapon)

### 2) Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon — *Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen*
- **Carian Regal Scepter** (staff weapon)
- **Rennala’s Full Moon** (sorcery)

### 3) Starscourge Radahn — *Remembrance of the Starscourge*
- **Starscourge Greatsword** (weapon)
- **Lion Greatbow** (weapon)

### 4) Regal Ancestor Spirit — *Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor*
- **Winged Greathorn** (weapon)
- **Ancestral Spirit’s Horn** (talisman)

### 5) Morgott, the Omen King — *Remembrance of the Omen King*
- **Morgott’s Cursed Sword** (weapon)
- **Regal Omen Bairn** (usable tool/item)

### 6) Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy — *Remembrance of the Blasphemous*
- **Blasphemous Blade** (weapon)
- **Rykard’s Rancor** (sorcery)

### 7) Astel, Naturalborn of the Void — *Remembrance of the Naturalborn*
- **Bastard’s Stars** (weapon)
- **Ash of War: Waves of Darkness** (Ash of War)

### 8) Lichdragon Fortissax — *Remembrance of the Lichdragon*
- **Fortissax’s Lightning Spear** (incantation)
- **Death Lightning** (incantation)

### 9) Fire Giant — *Remembrance of the Fire Giant*
- **Giant’s Red Braid** (weapon)
- **Burn, O Flame!** (incantation)

### 10) Mohg, Lord of Blood — *Remembrance of the Blood Lord*
- **Mohgwyn’s Sacred Spear** (weapon)
- **Bloodboon** (incantation)

### 11) Malenia, Blade of Miquella — *Remembrance of the Rot Goddess*
- **Hand of Malenia** (weapon)
- **Scarlet Aeonia** (incantation)

### 12) Maliketh, the Black Blade — *Remembrance of the Black Blade*
- **Maliketh’s Black Blade** (weapon)
- **Black Blade** (incantation)

### 13) Dragonlord Placidusax — *Remembrance of the Dragonlord*
- **Dragon King’s Cragblade** (weapon)
- **Placidusax’s Ruin** (incantation)

### 14) Godfrey, First Elden Lord / Hoarah Loux — *Remembrance of Hoarah Loux*
- **Axe of Godfrey** (weapon)
- **Ash of War: Hoarah Loux’s Earthshaker** (Ash of War)

### 15) Elden Beast — *Elden Remembrance*
- **Sacred Relic Sword** (weapon)
- **Marika’s Hammer** (weapon)

---

## Notes (base game)
- **No Remembrance has more than 2 trade-in rewards.**
- **No Remembrance requires extra items/conditions** to trade beyond having the Remembrance and access to Enia.
- **Shardbearer (demigod) Remembrances** generally require a **bell** Walking Mausoleum to duplicate (if you want both rewards in one playthrough).

all_scores.question: Você pode fazer um relatório sobre todos os chefes de lembrança de Elden Ring considerando apenas o jogo base? Quero saber todas as recompensas que podem ser trocadas por cada lembrança.
all_scores.response:
Below is a base-game–only report of every **Remembrance boss** in *Elden Ring* and **all rewards** you can trade that boss’s **Remembrance** for at **Finger Reader Enia** (Roundtable Hold → “Receive power from remembrance”).  
(Each Remembrance has **exactly two** trade-in rewards; you can get both in one playthrough by **duplicating** the Remembrance at a Walking Mausoleum.)

---

## 1) Godrick the Grafted — *Remembrance of the Grafted*
- **Axe of Godrick** — Greataxe (weapon)  
- **Grafted Dragon** — Fist (weapon)

## 2) Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon — *Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen*
- **Carian Regal Scepter** — Glintstone Staff (weapon/catalyst)  
- **Rennala’s Full Moon** — Sorcery

## 3) Starscourge Radahn — *Remembrance of the Starscourge*
- **Starscourge Greatsword** — Colossal Sword (weapon)  
- **Lion Greatbow** — Greatbow (weapon)

## 4) Regal Ancestor Spirit — *Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor*
- **Winged Greathorn** — Greataxe (weapon)  
- **Ancestral Spirit’s Horn** — Hammer (weapon)

## 5) Morgott, the Omen King — *Remembrance of the Omen King*
- **Morgott’s Cursed Sword** — Curved Greatsword (weapon)  
- **Regal Omen Bairn** — Tool / reusable item

## 6) Astel, Naturalborn of the Void — *Remembrance of the Naturalborn*
- **Bastard’s Stars** — Flail (weapon)  
- **Ash of War: Waves of Darkness** — Ash of War

## 7) Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy — *Remembrance of the Blasphemous*
- **Blasphemous Blade** — Greatsword (weapon)  
- **Rykard’s Rancor** — Sorcery

## 8) Lichdragon Fortissax — *Remembrance of the Lichdragon*
- **Fortissax’s Lightning Spear** — Incantation  
- **Death Lightning** — Incantation

## 9) Fire Giant — *Remembrance of the Fire Giant*
- **Giant’s Red Braid** — Whip (weapon)  
- **Burn, O Flame!** — Incantation

## 10) Mohg, Lord of Blood — *Remembrance of the Blood Lord*
- **Mohgwyn’s Sacred Spear** — Great Spear (weapon)  
- **Bloodboon** — Incantation

## 11) Maliketh, the Black Blade — *Remembrance of the Black Blade*
- **Maliketh’s Black Blade** — Colossal Sword (weapon)  
- **Black Blade** — Incantation

## 12) Dragonlord Placidusax — *Remembrance of the Dragonlord*
- **Dragon King’s Cragblade** — Heavy Thrusting Sword (weapon)  
- **Placidusax’s Ruin** — Incantation

## 13) Godfrey, First Elden Lord / Hoarah Loux — *Remembrance of Hoarah Loux*
- **Axe of Godfrey** — Greataxe (weapon)  
- **Ash of War: Hoarah Loux’s Earthshaker** — Ash of War

## 14) Malenia, Blade of Miquella — *Remembrance of the Rot Goddess*
- **Hand of Malenia** — Katana (weapon)  
- **Scarlet Aeonia** — Incantation

## 15) Radagon of the Golden Order / Elden Beast — *Elden Remembrance*
- **Sacred Relic Sword** — Greatsword (weapon)  
- **Marika’s Hammer** — Hammer (weapon)

---

### Notes (to avoid common confusion)
- **Consuming** a Remembrance for runes is *not* a third trade reward—just the normal “use item” option.
- Some bosses unlock **armor** in Enia’s **shop**, but that’s separate from the Remembrance trade menu.
- In the base game, every Remembrance has **two** exchange rewards (no exceptions).

If you want, I can put this into a downloadable-style table (CSV/Google Sheets format) or add where each boss is located and what stat requirements the weapons/spells have.
